notes: Company background: mid-market subscription billing platform that manages invoicing, proration, and refunds for SaaS customers.
Primary objective: deploy chat-based support agents to handle billing/subscription questions, quick lookups, and automated actions (refund, retry payment, change plan).
Key requirement: tool calling into Stripe + Zuora to perform actions. JSON structured output required for downstream orchestration (strict schema).
Latency SLO: 95th <= 450ms for agent responses where we proxy user -> Redwood -> tool -> return. Streaming responses preferred for perceived latency (token streaming).
Throughput: support peak of ~80 concurrent agents during weekday business hours. Expect bursty patterns around EOM billing runs.
Cost sensitivity: wants to start on Hosted API POC; if latency/cost predictable, will evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit).
Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO/SAML integration; data residency preference for NA; audit logs + KMS required for Private/dedicated discussions.
Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated open models; prefer a deterministic JSON extractor plugin and ability to pin model version for POC.
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model for low-sensitivity tasks and fail-open to human handoff on payment-sensitive actions.
Integration notes: Zuora API rate limits are a concern; want Redwood to support batching/queueing of tool calls and retry semantics.
Quote from call: 'We need the agent to confidently say whether a charge was successful and, if needed, initiate a refund — check Zuora, not guess.'

POC scope: 1) implement chat agent using Hosted API, 2) tool calling for Stripe + Zuora sandbox, 3) streaming + structured JSON output for orchestration, 4) latency benchmarks at 95th/99th percentiles, 5) cost estimate for Dedicated if SLOs not met on Hosted.
POC success criteria: meets 95th <= 450ms for normal flows (no heavy billing history retrieval), structured JSON schema passes automated tests, security checklist signed off by infosec.
Open question: whether Redwood's streaming latency includes end-to-end tool call time or only generation latency — need clarification during POC kickoff.
